name: InvocationPanel
summary: One execution: what was asked, the steps, what came out.

a11y.apg: disclosure — each step with a body is a native <details>, so opening and closing is the platform's, keyboard included
a11y.keyboardNote: Measured in a browser on 29/08/2026 (apps/keyboard-probe + tests/visual/teclado-motor.spec.ts). This ficha comes from the lineage that did not have check 30, so it declared keys with no measurement behind them — the merge of the two lineages on 29/08/2026 is what surfaced it. Confirmed: Enter, which opens a step's detail. Each step that has a body is a native <details>/<summary>. Space is declared and did not toggle it in Chromium build 1194 — same direct measurement, same reason for keeping it, as InterAgentMessage.

props.name: title
props.description: Names the panel, and names the region for a screen reader when it is a string.

props.name: input
props.description: What was asked. Yours to format — a prompt, a form, a payload.

props.name: steps
props.description: What happened in between. A step with `content` becomes a native <details>: folding is platform behaviour, with keyboard and ARIA already in it, where the reference spends a library Collapsible to arrive at the same place.

props.name: running
props.description: Marks `aria-busy` on the whole region. The reference animates the label with a shimmer instead — decoration a screen reader cannot reach and that reduced-motion would have to undo.
